skill.summary: 微信公众号文章批量抓取工具，支持批量抓取公众号历史文章、导出为Markdown/HTML格式、自动提取封面图、标签、阅读量等数据。集成SkillPay支付接口，每次调用收0.001USDT。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of WeChat Official Account article batch scraping tool
- Supports bulk scraping of official account history articles
- Export articles in Markdown, HTML, or plain text formats
- Automatically extracts article metadata including cover image, tags, views, author, etc.
- Prevents duplicate scraping of articles
- Allows bulk download of article images
- Integrated SkillPay payment (0.001 USDT per use)
